test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
In the following questions a statement has been given with highlighted text. Select the options that can replace the text with correct idiom or phrase. 

The attitude of the culprit made the judge__ extemely angry__.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Make one's blood boil"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's see the sentence with the idiom:

__
 
• The attitude of the culprit ***made the judge's blood boil .***

*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__***Let's see the other idioms:

 
• **Throw caution to the wind -** To abandon one's cautiousness in order to take a risk.

 
 
• ***Eg***. You can't live life completely reserved, you know. You've got to *throw caution to the wind* every now and then. 
 
 
 
• **Play by the ear - **perform music without having to read from a score.
 
 
• ***Eg.*** She could* play both by ear* and by reading.
 
 
 
• **Back to the drawing board - **Revising something (such as a plan) from the beginning, typically after it has failed.
 
 
• ***Eg. ***That ad campaign was not as successful as we had hoped. *Back to the drawing board.****​***
